Dear Harbor Logistics team,

With eight years of experience building backend systems specifically for marketplaces and logistics, I am well-prepared for the Senior Backend Engineer role. My proven track record includes owning a shipment tracking platform composed of Go services that process carrier events using Kafka and maintain accuracy through PostgreSQL.

At my current position, I successfully led the migration from a monolithic architecture to an event-driven service model without incurring downtime. This hands-on experience with distributed systems has sharpened my ability to create resilient solutions. Implementing idempotent consumers was a critical improvement stemming from a past issue with duplicated deliveries, showcasing my commitment to system reliability.

I also reduced the p99 latency of our tracking API from 900 milliseconds to 120 milliseconds. This significant performance enhancement demonstrates my focus on optimizing user experience and system efficiency. Furthermore, I established observability practices by setting up tracing and SLO dashboards, which are essential for monitoring and maintaining high service quality.

Apart from technical contributions, I actively mentor mid-level engineers and contribute to our architecture decision records. My passion for hard correctness problems and clear communication aligns with teams that integrate operations into their product development. I am eager to leverage my background to enhance routing and warehouse systems at Harbor Logistics.

Sincerely,
